owner.instruction: Create src/lib/types.ts exporting shared domain types: Project (id, name, createdAt), Task (id, projectId, title, deadline, status: 'not_started'|'in_progress'|'completed', assignedTo: string|null, createdAt), Member (id, name, email), and response types ProjectListResponse {items: Project[]}, TaskListResponse {items: Task[]}, MemberListResponse {items: Member[]}, ErrorResponse {error: string, details?: string}. Create src/lib/store.ts exporting async functions: readData(), writeData(data), and helper functions getProjects(), addProject(), getTasks(), addTask(), updateTaskStatus(), getMembers(), addMember(). Use JSON file persistence in a data.json file at project root. Initialize only on ENOENT; on parse error or I/O failure return 5xx without overwriting. Use write-to-temp-then-rename for atomic writes.
